_doc: Fight-screen text rules (ux-ui 2026-11-25, Boss: the fight HUD must stay CLEAN). Read by client/fight_text_rules.gd (display only, never changes combat). Every floating word in a fight goes through one lane per fighter: at most lane_lines lines, the same word within merge_seconds merges into 'WORD x2' instead of stacking, a full lane drops its oldest line, and the whole screen holds at most budget.phone / budget.desktop texts (phone = aspect >= 2.0, e.g. 844x390). categories: 'lane' = a floating line over the fighter, 'hide' = no text at all, 'icon' = only a status icon (squad card for our team, a small icon row over the enemy's bar), 'feed' = the HUD's corner loot feed, 'top' = the single top-centre lane (combo payoffs, one at a time), 'once' = a lane line only the first time per fighter within once_seconds (big control: stun, shock, sleep).

numbers._doc: Damage numbers: a hit shows a number only when it is a crit, a combo payoff, or at least big_hit_fraction of the target's max HP. Heals show only when the healed amount is at least heal_fraction of max HP. scale multiplies the atlas digit size; spread_px is the sideways scatter (each new number alternates sides); life is in seconds.

status_icons._doc: Small status icons (shape + colour + glyph, so they read without colour). Shapes are the combo icon shapes (client/combo_ui.gd). max_icons per fighter; the rest becomes '+n'.

size._doc: icon radius = max(min_px, radius * screen scale). Phone min raised 2026-11-25: at 844x390 the scale is 0.45, so radius alone gave 7 px icons that could not be read.
